Coaching members: the Hearth

AI fluency coaching and training.

When AI can do something new, so can you.

Time with someone who knows AI deeply and makes it simple.

Elliot uses AI every day and keeps up with every new capability. He has mentored software engineers and people new to AI, and he starts from the work in front of you, whatever your role.

Who it's for

  • You, one to one

    Regular sessions with Elliot, built on the questions, decisions and ideas in front of you. No technical background needed.

    Each session builds on the last, and every one leaves you a record: the summary, what you decided, and a playbook of things to try.

  • Executive teams

    For leaders who are paying for AI and want to get far more from it, and to set the direction for everyone else.

  • Engineering teams

    Agentic engineering training: building software with AI agents that plan, write and verify code. On site or remote.

    We teach the habits that keep a team current: picking up each new capability early, and reviewing how you work every time a new model ships.

  • As a company benefit

    Coaching for your people, as a benefit you offer the whole company. Everyone learns from the work they already do.

Each new model can do more, and some old habits start to cost you.

With the current Claude Opus models, high effort costs more and drifts from what you asked, and low or medium effort gives better answers. A team still on its old settings pays more for worse work.

AI enablement for companies

Company AI policy, structure and enablement, from someone who led AI enablement at Campminder for two and a half years and then built AI platforms as an engineer.

The Hearth

Members book sessions in their own timezone, keep the record of every session, review what they learned, and can connect their own AI agent.
